slides.headline: 5 PROMPTS THAT GIVE EVERY NEW HIRE A 30-DAY PLAN BEFORE THEY START
slides.image_prompt: Dario Amodei in khaki drill sergeant uniform thrusting a large sheet marked '30-DAY PLAN'; silhouetted recruits stand at attention on sunlit parade ground behind; Claude logo blazes on amber banner; documentary photograph.

slides.headline: 1) BUILD A 30-DAY TRAINING PLAN FOR ANY ROLE
slides.body: A business consultant charges $2,500 to $5,000 to pull your process out and structure it. This prompt does the same thing in under 5 minutes.

slides.headline: 2) TURN YOUR OWN PROCESS INTO A STEP-BY-STEP SOP
slides.body: Every time you hire someone, you spend 3 to 5 hours re-explaining the same things. A written SOP stops that permanently.

slides.headline: EVERY NEW HIRE COSTS $4,700
slides.body: That is the SHRM national average for cost per hire. Most of it is time, not cash, recruiting, handholding, and mistakes on a job nobody documented.

slides.headline: 3) BUILD A QUIZ THAT CATCHES GAPS BEFORE WEEK TWO
slides.body: The US Department of Labor puts the average bad hire at 30% of their first-year salary. Most of that damage happens in the first two weeks.

slides.headline: 4) WRITE THE WHO TO ASK FOR WHAT GUIDE
slides.body: New hires spend their first two weeks not knowing who to interrupt. You end up answering the same questions on repeat every time someone new joins.

slides.headline: 5) CREATE A WELCOME PACKET THEY READ BEFORE DAY ONE
slides.body: Nearly 1 in 3 new hires quit within 90 days. The most common reason: no one made expectations clear. Most businesses hand people a Wi-Fi password and a handshake.

caption:
Swipe through 5 Claude prompts that build your entire new-hire training program tonight. 🗂️ Most owners have nothing written down. These fix that.

1) 30-day training plan for any role,
2) step-by-step SOPs from your own head,
3) week-one quiz that catches gaps before they set,
4) who-to-ask guide that stops repeat questions,
5) day-one welcome packet they read alone

Anthropic cut rates 17% today. OpenAI reset Codex and ChatGPT Work to last 10 to 50% longer. SHRM puts the average cost per hire at $4,700, most of it in training time. These prompts extract your whole process in one evening. Running a business? DM us "AI" and we'll show you what this could do for yours.

Sources: SHRM, US Department of Labor, Jobvite, Anthropic, OpenAI
